title: Count the distinct spellings in the other counters
lead: `nullSpellingsOther` and `allNullRowSpellingsOther` give the number of cells or rows whose spelling went past the bounds, not how many different spellings they hold. Add a distinct count for fields and for all-null rows (for example `nullSpellingsOtherDistinct` and `allNullRowSpellingsOtherDistinct`), exact or capped and marked as such. **Not in this slice:** keeping the dropped spellings themselves in the descriptor; changing the 64 and 256 bounds; configurable bounds.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A consumer cannot tell "one long spelling" from "many" when some spellings went past the bounds. Use case: decide whether a column of nulls has a single spelling when some of its spellings are in the "other" counter. With the count, `keys(nullSpellings) + nullSpellingsOtherDistinct` is the number of distinct spellings, and a column is single-spelled when that is 1. Today `SpellingCounter` keeps only a total in `Other`, so it forgets the dropped spellings and the distinct count cannot be recovered. Related: sq-36 (the members), sq-38 (sketch budget, if the answer to Q3 is a sketch), sq-32 (bytes-per-field target; a new per-field member costs bytes only for fields that spill).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `SpellingCounter` (`src/squalify/Fields/SpellingCounter.cs`), `FieldAccumulator`, `RowClassAccumulator`, the field profile and `RowClassesInfo` records (`src/squalify/Descriptor/`), `DescriptorWriter`
- docs/descriptor.md (the `nullSpellings`, `nullSpellingsOther`, `allNullRowSpellings` paragraphs, the consumer subset and the invariants in F9), design.md (memory of the counter), user-guide.md, README if it names the members; how-it-works.md if the diagram text changes; goldens that spill

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- **One long spelling:** 1,000 nulls that all use one 300-character spelling give `nullSpellingsOther == 1000` and `nullSpellingsOtherDistinct == 1`.
- **Many spellings:** a field with 200 distinct null spellings (64 kept) gives `nullSpellingsOther` equal to the cells of the other 136 and `nullSpellingsOtherDistinct == 64` with `nullSpellingsOtherDistinctCapped` true (K = 64); with 100 distinct (36 dropped) the count is exactly 36 and no capped marker is written.
- **Recurrence and causes:** a dropped spelling that recurs counts once; spellings dropped by the 64 bound and spellings over 256 characters each count once, compared as exact text (not trimmed: ` NULL` and `NULL` differ).
- **All-null rows:** the same cases for `allNullRowSpellingsOther` and `allNullRowSpellingsOtherDistinct` (always written, 0 when none); the row marker is written only when the cap is hit (state the choice in descriptor.md).
- **No spill, no member:** a field with nothing in "other" leaves out `nullSpellingsOtherDistinct` (and the marker); narrow goldens change only by the limits member below.
- **limits:** `limits.nullSpellings` (from sq-42) gains the cap (name it, for example `maxDistinctOther`: 64), always written; the test reads the counter constant.
- **Memory:** the counter `EstimatedBytes` covers the remembered hashes; a 2,000-column stream where every field spills stays inside the memory allowance (sq-11, sq-38); the sq-32 bytes-per-field size test still holds.
- **Invariants:** `sum(nullSpellings) + nullSpellingsOther == nulls` and the all-null-row equivalent are unchanged; the distinct count is at most the other count, and at least 1 when the other count is positive.
- Mutation-check: counting a recurring spelling twice, dropping the long-spelling case, not counting spellings past the 64 bound, an off-by-one at K, and the capped marker, each fail a test above.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests above (after sq-42 has landed, so limits.nullSpellings exists).
2. `SpellingCounter`: remember a hash (XxHash64 of the UTF-16 text, plus the length so equal hashes of different lengths differ) of up to 64 further distinct dropped spellings, count them, and set a capped flag past that; charge them in `EstimatedBytes`. Field profile and `RowClassesInfo` gain the members (trailing optional, like sq-36 did); the writer writes `nullSpellingsOtherDistinct` (omitted at 0) and `nullSpellingsOtherDistinctCapped` (only when true) per field, and `allNullRowSpellingsOtherDistinct` (always) with its marker (only when true) in `table.rowClasses`.
3. Add the cap to `limits.nullSpellings` (always written).
4. Docs in the same change: descriptor.md (the nullSpellings, nullSpellingsOther and allNullRowSpellings paragraphs, the invariants in F9, the consumer subset, the key-order rows, the versioning-policy sentence), design.md (the counter memory), user-guide.md, how-it-works.md if text changes; rewrite and review the goldens.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.
